title: Card transaction the customer does not recognise
context: Current account ending 4417. A card payment of 248.99 to an online merchant on the 8th is disputed. The card is in the customer's possession. The agent can raise a chargeback, can block and reissue the card, and cannot credit the amount before the dispute is assessed.
customer_turns: There is a payment of two hundred and forty-eight ninety-nine on my account ending 4417 from the eighth. I do not recognise the merchant name and I did not authorise it.
My card has not left my wallet and nobody else uses it. I did buy something online the day before, which is the only use.
Please block the card and start whatever dispute process applies. Tell me how long it takes and whether I get the money back in the meantime.
resolution_space: Block and reissue the card and raise a chargeback
Raise a fraud claim with a provisional credit where eligible
Advise the customer to contact the merchant first
Escalate to the fraud team

title: Overdraft interest after a promised buffer
context: Account ending 2290. Overdraft interest of 18.60 was charged for six days. The notes record an agreed fee-free buffer of 100.00 arranged on a call in July, which was never applied to the account. The agent can refund charges arising from an unapplied arrangement.
customer_turns: I have been charged eighteen sixty in overdraft interest on the account ending 2290. I was told in July that I would have a hundred pound buffer with no charges.
I went about sixty pounds overdrawn for less than a week, which should have been inside that buffer. Nothing on my statements suggests the buffer was ever there.
Can you check the July call and put this right? I want the eighteen sixty back and the buffer actually applied going forward.
resolution_space: Refund the interest and apply the agreed buffer
Apply the buffer going forward without refunding past interest
Uphold the charges if no arrangement is evidenced
Escalate to the complaints team

title: Foreign transaction fees on a fee-free account
context: Account ending 7736 on a travel tier advertised with no foreign transaction fees. Six fees totalling 14.20 were charged. The tier upgrade completed one day after the transactions. The agent can refund fees as goodwill up to 25.00.
customer_turns: My account ending 7736 has six foreign transaction fees on it totalling fourteen twenty. I upgraded to the travel account specifically so that would not happen.
I upgraded before the trip, or at least I clicked through the upgrade before I flew. The charges are all from my first two days away.
Refund the fourteen twenty if you can. If the upgrade genuinely landed after the charges, say so and I will accept that.
resolution_space: Refund the fees as goodwill under the allowance
Explain the upgrade effective date and uphold the fees
Backdate the tier upgrade to the application date
Escalate to the product team

title: Direct debit collected after cancellation
context: Account ending 5512. A direct debit for 62.00 was collected four days after the customer cancelled the mandate in the app. The cancellation is recorded. Under the direct debit guarantee the agent can issue an immediate indemnity refund.
customer_turns: A direct debit of sixty-two pounds came out of the account ending 5512 four days after I cancelled it in your app. The app still shows it as cancelled.
I cancelled because I had already closed the account with that company. They have no right to be taking anything and I told them so in writing last month.
I want the sixty-two pounds back from you today under the guarantee, not in a week once you have asked them about it.
resolution_space: Issue an immediate indemnity refund under the direct debit guarantee
Investigate with the originator before refunding
Refund and place a block on future collections from that originator
Escalate to the payments team

title: Duplicate card payment at a retailer
context: Card ending 8890. Two identical payments of 74.50 to the same retailer are posted ninety seconds apart; one is still pending. The agent can advise on the pending item, can raise a duplicate-transaction dispute once posted, and cannot cancel a pending authorisation.
customer_turns: My card ending 8890 shows two payments of seventy-four fifty to the same shop, ninety seconds apart. I only made one purchase and I have one receipt.
The assistant did say the terminal had failed the first time and asked me to tap again. Clearly it did not fail, because both attempts are on my statement.
Which one do I get back, and do I have to go back to the shop first? Tell me the fastest route to my money.
resolution_space: Raise a duplicate-transaction dispute once the pending item posts
Advise contacting the retailer for a direct refund first
Monitor the pending item and refund if it settles
Escalate to the disputes team

title: Monthly account fee on an account sold as free
context: Account ending 3308. A 9.95 monthly account fee has been charged for seven months. The account was opened on a free tier and auto-migrated to a packaged tier during a product change, with notice sent by post. The agent can refund up to three months and can switch back to a free tier.
customer_turns: I have been charged nine ninety-five a month on the account ending 3308 for seven months. I opened this account because it was advertised as free banking.
I never agreed to any package. I do not use the travel insurance or the breakdown cover that apparently come with it, and I have never made a claim on either.
Put me back on a free account and tell me how much of the seventy pounds you are returning. I want the figure now.
resolution_space: Switch to a free tier and refund three months of fees
Switch to a free tier and refund all seven months as goodwill
Switch tier with no refund, citing the posted notice
Escalate to the complaints team

title: Transfer not arrived at the recipient bank
context: Payment reference TX-99210 for 1,200.00 sent three days ago to another bank. The payment shows as sent and accepted by the scheme. The agent can raise a trace with a two-working-day response and cannot recall a completed payment unilaterally.
customer_turns: I sent twelve hundred pounds three days ago under reference TX-99210 and the recipient says nothing has arrived. My app shows it as sent and completed.
It is going to a builder who has now stopped work until he is paid. The sort code and account number were copied straight from his invoice.
Can you trace it and tell me where the money is now? I need something in writing that I can show him today.
resolution_space: Raise a payment trace and provide written confirmation of sending
Attempt a recall if a misdirection is identified
Provide the scheme reference for the recipient's bank to investigate
Escalate to the payments investigations team

title: Replacement debit card not delivered
context: Card order CD-30118 dispatched twelve days ago by standard post to the registered address. Standard delivery is five working days. The agent can cancel the card in transit, issue a courier replacement for next day, and can enable digital wallet use immediately.
customer_turns: My replacement debit card under CD-30118 was sent twelve days ago and has not arrived. I have had no working card that whole time.
I have been using cash and my partner's card, which is not sustainable. There is nothing being held at the delivery office and the address on file is correct.
Please get me a card quickly, and if there is any way for me to pay by phone before it arrives, set that up too.
resolution_space: Cancel the card in transit and issue a courier replacement
Enable digital wallet provisioning immediately
Arrange branch collection of a replacement card
Escalate to the card services team

title: Account opening stuck in verification
context: Application AP-77201, submitted seventeen days ago, status in verification. The identity document uploaded is expired. No notification was sent to the applicant. The agent can request a new document and can complete verification within one working day of receipt.
customer_turns: I applied for an account seventeen days ago, application AP-77201, and it still says in verification. Nothing has been asked of me since I submitted everything.
I need the account open to receive my salary on the twenty-eighth. My employer needs the details at least a week before that to set it up.
Tell me what is holding it up and what you need from me. If it cannot be done by the twenty-first, I need to know now.
resolution_space: Request a valid identity document and commit to a one-day turnaround
Offer branch verification as a faster route
Withdraw and resubmit the application
Escalate to the onboarding team

title: Cheque deposit not cleared
context: Cheque deposit of 450.00 made by mobile capture nine days ago. Standard clearing is two working days. The deposit is held pending a manual review because the image was partially illegible. The agent can request a re-deposit or release after review.
customer_turns: I paid in a cheque for four hundred and fifty pounds nine days ago using the app. It is still showing as processing.
It was a refund cheque from my landlord and the funds are already out of his account, he tells me. So it has clearly been presented somewhere.
When will it clear? If it is not clearing, tell me so I can ask him to pay me another way instead.
resolution_space: Release the deposit after completing the manual review
Reject the deposit and ask the customer to re-deposit or bank the original
Provide a provisional credit while the review completes
Escalate to the deposits team

title: Standing order missed on the due date
context: Standing order SO-22104 for 380.00 monthly rent, due on the 1st, not executed because the 1st fell on a bank holiday and the instruction is set to non-working-day skip. The agent can send the payment today and can change the rule to next working day.
customer_turns: My standing order SO-22104 for three hundred and eighty pounds did not go out on the first. It is my rent and the landlord has now charged me a late fee.
The money was in the account the whole time, so it was not a shortage. This has never happened in the two years the standing order has been running.
Send it now if you can, and change whatever setting caused this. I also want something in writing explaining it for my landlord.
resolution_space: Send the payment today and change the non-working-day rule
Provide a written explanation for the landlord
Refund the late fee as goodwill
Escalate to the payments team

title: Mortgage offer decision overdue
context: Mortgage application MG-45023, submitted twenty-four days ago; the published service level for an offer decision is fifteen working days. The case is awaiting a valuation booking. The agent can chase the valuer and cannot commit to a decision date.
customer_turns: My mortgage application MG-45023 was submitted twenty-four days ago and there is still no decision. Your website says fifteen working days for an offer.
The seller has given us until the end of next week before they remarket the property. We have already paid for the survey on our side.
What is the actual hold-up and what date can you give me? If no date is possible, tell me that plainly so we can talk to the seller.
resolution_space: Chase the valuation booking and confirm the next milestone date
Request case prioritisation given the seller deadline
Provide written confirmation of application progress for the seller
Escalate to the mortgage underwriting team

title: Mobile app will not open after an update
context: Customer profile ending 6621. The app closes at launch on the customer's device; the fault matches a known incompatibility with an older operating system version. The agent can offer browser banking, telephone banking, and cannot fix the device.
customer_turns: Your app closes immediately every time I open it on my phone, since the update last week. It shows the logo for a second and then disappears.
I have reinstalled it twice and restarted the phone. My phone is a few years old and cannot take any more operating system updates, if that matters.
Give me a way to bank today that works with what I have. I need to move money before this evening is out.
resolution_space: Set up browser banking access on the same device
Register the customer for telephone banking
Arrange a branch appointment for the transaction
Escalate to the digital channels team

title: Card declined despite sufficient funds
context: Card ending 1102. Three declines in two days with a balance of 2,300.00. The declines come from a fraud rule triggered by an unusual merchant category. The agent can remove the block, add a travel or spending note, and cannot guarantee future rules will not trigger.
customer_turns: My card ending 1102 was declined three times in the last two days even though there is over two thousand pounds in the account.
It happened at a garden centre and twice at a fuel station on the motorway. I was travelling for work and had to borrow money from a colleague.
Take whatever block is on it off, and tell me how to stop this happening again while I am still away from home.
resolution_space: Remove the fraud block and add a travel note
Reissue the card with a clean profile
Explain the rule and advise on pre-notifying unusual spending
Escalate to the fraud prevention team

title: Statement figures disagree between app and PDF
context: Account ending 9945. The app shows an available balance of 812.00 while the downloaded statement closes at 874.00. The difference is a pending card authorisation of 62.00. The agent can explain the pending item and can supply a certified statement.
customer_turns: The balance in your app for the account ending 9945 says eight hundred and twelve, but the statement I downloaded ends at eight hundred and seventy-four.
My accountant will not accept two different figures for the same date. She needs one number she can put in the return, which is due next week.
Explain which is right and send me something official that states it. I need it in a form I can forward to her.
resolution_space: Explain the pending authorisation and issue a certified statement
Reissue the statement with pending items disclosed
Provide a written balance confirmation letter
Escalate to the account services team

title: Card reader for online authentication failing
context: Customer profile ending 4480. The card reader used for online authentication returns an error code indicating a flat battery or a chip mismatch. The agent can send a replacement reader within three days and can enable app-based authentication immediately.
customer_turns: The card reader I use to authorise payments online keeps showing an error code and will not produce a code at all. It worked fine until Tuesday.
I have tried it with two of my cards and the same thing happens. I cannot make any payment to a new payee, which is the only reason I use it.
I need to pay an invoice today. Is there another way to authorise it, and can you send me a working reader as well?
resolution_space: Enable app-based authentication immediately
Send a replacement card reader within three days
Authorise the payment through telephone banking
Escalate to the digital security team

title: Savings interest calculated at the wrong rate
context: Savings account ending 5077, advertised at 4.10 percent. Interest paid corresponds to 3.10 percent for two months because a rate change was not applied at migration. The agent can recalculate and pay the shortfall and can correct the rate going forward.
customer_turns: The interest on my savings account ending 5077 looks wrong. I opened it at four point one percent and what has been paid works out at just over three.
I checked two months of statements and both are short by about the same proportion. The rate shown in the app today still says four point one.
Work out what I am owed and pay it. Then confirm the rate is right going forward so I do not have to check every month.
resolution_space: Recalculate and pay the interest shortfall, correcting the rate
Correct the rate going forward only
Provide a full interest calculation for the customer to review
Escalate to the savings product team

title: Payee added but payments keep failing
context: Account ending 6690. Payments to a newly added payee fail with a name-check mismatch because the payee is a business trading under a different registered name. The agent can explain the confirmation-of-payee result and can allow the customer to proceed on an override.
customer_turns: I added a new payee on the account ending 6690 and every payment to it fails. The app says the name does not match and stops me before I can confirm.
The invoice is from a shop trading under one name but the bank details are presumably in the company's registered name, which I do not know.
How do I pay them? Either tell me how to get past the check or tell me what to ask the supplier for.
resolution_space: Explain the name-check result and allow the customer to proceed on an override
Advise obtaining the registered account name from the supplier
Process the payment through telephone banking with verification
Escalate to the payments team

title: Cancelling a packaged account within the cooling-off period
context: Packaged account ending 2201, opened nine days ago at 12.00 per month. The cooling-off period is fourteen days with a full fee refund. No insurance claims have been made. The agent can downgrade or close and refund the fee.
customer_turns: I opened a packaged account ending 2201 nine days ago at twelve pounds a month and I want to cancel it. The benefits duplicate cover I already have elsewhere.
I have not claimed on any of the insurance and I have not used the account for anything beyond a single test payment of one pound to myself.
Can I get the fee back and move to a plain account? Tell me whether the account number stays the same, and whether my card changes.
resolution_space: Downgrade to a free account and refund the fee
Close the account entirely and refund the fee
Retain the account with the fee waived for three months
Escalate to the product team

title: Stopping a recurring card payment to a merchant
context: Card ending 3345 with a recurring merchant payment of 29.99 monthly. The customer cancelled with the merchant but collections continue. The agent can block future recurring payments to that merchant and can dispute the last collection.
customer_turns: A gym takes twenty-nine ninety-nine a month from my card ending 3345. I cancelled with them in July and they have taken it twice since.
They say my cancellation was not received, and their online form gives me an error whenever I try again. It is not a direct debit, it is on the card.
Block them at your end and get the last two payments back if you can. Tell me which of those you can actually do.
resolution_space: Block future recurring payments to that merchant
Dispute the collections taken after cancellation
Reissue the card with a new number
Escalate to the disputes team

title: Cancelling a loan application before drawdown
context: Loan application LN-55712 approved for 8,000.00, funds not yet released, agreement signed two days ago. The withdrawal right is fourteen days. No fee applies before drawdown. The agent can cancel and confirm nothing is owed.
customer_turns: I signed a loan agreement two days ago under LN-55712 for eight thousand pounds and I want to cancel it. The money has not been paid out yet.
The purchase I needed it for has fallen through, so I no longer need the loan at all. I would rather not have it sitting on my credit file.
Confirm it is cancelled, that I owe nothing, and what happens to the record of it. I want all three in writing.
resolution_space: Cancel the agreement and confirm no sums are owed
Cancel and provide written confirmation for credit reference purposes
Reduce the loan amount instead of cancelling
Escalate to the lending team

title: Refund for a failed international payment
context: International payment IP-88023 of 2,500.00 returned by the beneficiary bank after seven days. 2,455.00 was credited back; 45.00 in intermediary fees was deducted. The agent can refund the fees as goodwill where the return was not the customer's fault.
customer_turns: My international payment IP-88023 for two and a half thousand pounds was returned and only two thousand four hundred and fifty-five came back to me.
The return was because the beneficiary bank rejected it, not because I got anything wrong. The details I gave were exactly what my supplier sent.
I want the forty-five pounds of fees back too. Can you do that, and can you tell me what to change before I resend it?
resolution_space: Refund the intermediary fees as goodwill
Explain the fee deduction and uphold it
Resend the payment free of charge with corrected routing
Escalate to the international payments team

title: Closing a savings account with a notice period
context: Savings account ending 7712 with a 90-day notice requirement and a balance of 15,400.00. Immediate closure forfeits 90 days of interest, roughly 155.00. The agent can place a notice instruction or close immediately with the interest penalty.
customer_turns: I want to close the savings account ending 7712 and move the fifteen thousand four hundred to another bank offering a better rate.
I had forgotten it has a ninety-day notice period. The new rate offer I have been given expires at the end of this month, which is the problem.
Tell me what closing today costs me in interest, and what happens if I give notice instead. I will decide on this call.
resolution_space: Close immediately with the interest penalty applied
Place a 90-day notice instruction with a stated maturity date
Partially withdraw within any penalty-free allowance
Escalate to the savings team

title: Reversing a payment sent to the wrong account
context: Payment PY-66190 of 640.00 sent to an incorrect account number two hours ago. The receiving bank must consent to a return. The agent can raise a misdirected payment claim with a twenty-working-day framework and cannot guarantee recovery.
customer_turns: I sent six hundred and forty pounds two hours ago under PY-66190 and I typed one digit of the account number wrong. It has gone to a stranger.
The name check did warn me that the name did not match, and I clicked through it because I was in a hurry. I realise that was my mistake.
Is there any chance of getting it back, and what do you need from me right now? Please be straight with me about the odds.
resolution_space: Raise a misdirected payment claim under the recovery framework
Contact the receiving bank for consent to return the funds
Explain that recovery depends on the recipient and set expectations
Escalate to the payments investigations team

title: Locked out after failed security questions
context: Profile ending 8814. Online access is locked after three failed memorable-word attempts. Unlocking requires identity verification by card reader, app approval or branch visit. The customer has no app and a failing card reader.
customer_turns: I am locked out of online banking on the profile ending 8814 after getting my memorable word wrong. I set it years ago and clearly misremembered it.
I do not have your app on my phone, and the card reader you sent me stopped working last month. So neither of the usual routes is open to me.
How do I get back in? Give me all the options, including anything that does not need a working card reader, because mine is broken.
resolution_space: Verify identity on the call and reset online access
Arrange a branch identity check
Send a new card reader and reset afterwards
Escalate to the digital security team

title: Joint account access after a separation
context: Joint account ending 2266 held by two parties. One party asks to remove the other. Removal from a joint account requires both parties' consent or a court order; either party may convert the mandate to require both signatures unilaterally.
customer_turns: I want my former partner taken off the joint account ending 2266. We separated in June and I am the only one paying into it now.
He is not going to agree to anything at the moment and we are not speaking directly. I am worried about the balance while this is unresolved.
What can I do on my own, today, without his agreement? Tell me exactly what that does and does not achieve, so I know where I stand.
resolution_space: Convert the mandate to require both signatures for any withdrawal
Require both parties' consent before removing a holder
Open a sole account and redirect incoming payments
Escalate to the specialist support team

title: Managing an account for a relative
context: Account ending 4433 held by the customer's father, who is in long-term care. The customer holds a registered power of attorney document not yet recorded on the account. Registration requires document verification, usually taking five working days.
customer_turns: I need to manage my father's account ending 4433. He is in long-term care and can no longer deal with his own bills or correspondence.
I have a registered power of attorney document, but when I rang before I was told it is not showing on the account and I had to send it in.
Tell me exactly what to send, where to send it, and how long it takes. His care home invoice is due in two weeks.
resolution_space: Accept the power of attorney for verification with a stated timescale
Arrange branch verification of the original document
Set up an interim arrangement for the urgent invoice
Escalate to the vulnerable customer support team

title: Business account signatory change
context: Business account ending 7009 for a two-director company. One director has resigned and remains a signatory. A mandate change requires a resolution signed by the remaining directors plus identity verification for any new signatory.
customer_turns: I need to change the signatories on the business account ending 7009. One of our two directors resigned at the end of August and is still on the mandate.
Our new finance director started this week and needs to be able to approve payments. She has never held an account with you before.
What paperwork do you need and how long will this take? Payroll runs on the twenty-fifth and someone must be able to authorise it.
resolution_space: Accept a signed board resolution and verify the new signatory
Arrange an interim single-signatory authority for payroll
Require an in-branch appointment for all parties
Escalate to the business banking team

title: Blocked from registering a new device
context: Profile ending 1190. App registration on a new phone fails at the activation code step; the code is sent to a mobile number the customer has changed. Updating the number requires identity verification. The agent can verify on the call and update it.
customer_turns: I got a new phone and your app will not activate on it. It sends an activation code to a mobile number I stopped using in the spring.
My old phone is gone, so I cannot receive that code at all. The number on my account clearly never got updated when I switched.
Change the number to my current one and get me into the app. What do you need from me to prove who I am?
resolution_space: Verify identity on the call, update the number and reissue the code
Send an activation code by post to the registered address
Arrange branch verification before the change
Escalate to the digital security team

title: Address change rejected by verification
context: Account ending 3377. An online address change was rejected because the new address does not appear on the credit reference file yet. The agent can accept a recent utility bill or tenancy agreement and can update the address within two working days.
customer_turns: I moved house three weeks ago and your website will not accept my new address on the account ending 3377. It rejects it without saying why.
I am renting, and I have a tenancy agreement and a council tax bill in my name. My post is being redirected but that ends in a few months.
Tell me which document you will accept and how to send it. I want my statements going to the right place from now on.
resolution_space: Accept a tenancy agreement or utility bill and update within two working days
Require an in-branch identity and address check
Update the address once the credit file reflects it
Escalate to the account services team
